title: A batch hit twice by a transient lock is retried and stored once
actor: a user running the importer CLI from the repo root
state: the database file named in the steps does not exist yet
steps: IMPORTER_FAULTS=progress:2 /usr/bin/python3 -m importer import samples/products.csv --batch-size 2 --retries 3 --db <project>/.oldhand/csv-import-dupes/qa/evidence/S1/s1.db; echo exit=$?
expect: stderr shows two lines 'transient error (database is locked), retry 1/3' and 'retry 2/3'; the import prints 'import 1: 5 rows in 3 batches' and exit=0
list prints one line for import 1 with status done and 'batches=3 rows=5 stored=5' (stored is the count of rows actually in the database)
data: samples/products.csv (5 rows); IMPORTER_FAULTS is the project's own fault hook (importer/faults.py)

title: The reported case: one transient lock after the rows are written, then a retry
actor: a user running the importer CLI from the repo root
state: the database file named in the steps does not exist yet
steps: IMPORTER_FAULTS=progress:1 /usr/bin/python3 -m importer import samples/products.csv --batch-size 2 --retries 3 --db <project>/.oldhand/csv-import-dupes/qa/evidence/S2/s2.db; echo exit=$?
expect: stderr shows one 'retry 1/3' line; the import prints 'import 1: 5 rows in 3 batches' and exit=0
list shows 'done' and 'batches=3 rows=5 stored=5'; before the fix stored was 7

title: The lock outlasts the retries: the import fails visibly and leaves no doubled or half batch
actor: a user running the importer CLI from the repo root
state: the database file named in the steps does not exist yet
steps: IMPORTER_FAULTS=progress:5 /usr/bin/python3 -m importer import samples/products.csv --batch-size 2 --retries 1 --db <project>/.oldhand/csv-import-dupes/qa/evidence/S3/s3.db; echo exit=$?
expect: stderr ends with 'error: storage failed after retries: database is locked' and exit=1
list shows import 1 'failed' with 'batches=0 rows=0 stored=0' (judgement from the contract: no half-written or doubled batch is left)
